source_documents.title: Thermochromic aggregation-induced dual phosphorescence via temperature-dependent sp3-linked donor-acceptor electronic coupling

reference_evidence_units.quote: Distinct dual phosphorescence bands emitting from largely localized donor and acceptor triplet emitting states could be recorded at lowered temperatures; at room temperature, only a merged RTP band is present.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-6
reference_evidence_units.statement: Dual phosphorescence from donor- and acceptor-localized triplets.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The phenomenon is explained by the presence of a TPA-localized T1L state, which couples to a higher acceptor T1H state at room temperature, but cuts the electronic coupling off at lowered temperatures.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-6
reference_evidence_units.statement: Temperature-dependent coupling of two T1 minima.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the lowest singlet excited state (S1) is a dark state with a strong CT character
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-5

reference_evidence_units.quote: single-crystal purity TPA1 dissolved in PMMA were also recorded at various temperatures
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Dual phosphorescence persists for isolated TPA1.

reference_evidence_units.quote: all TPA aggregates in THF/water (5/95, v/v) contain long-lived emissions
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-5

reference_evidence_units.quote: due to the restriction of intramolecular motions and possibly newly emerged, lowest emissive states as aggregates
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-5
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No specific motion named beyond the AIE argument.
